title: Protector of Dresolik
summary: Fight the Protector of Dresolik within his guarded chamber.
overview: Fight the Protector of Dresolik within his guarded chamber.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep the boss inside the chamber to avoid a complete reset.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The protector checks his east-west room boundary every six seconds.
Crossing the boundary fully heals him, returns him to bind and clears hate.
He has a 30-minute out-of-combat despawn timer; victory produces a planar projection and warders.

notes: Approval E305. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
